title: AMC Global Media Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: AMC Networks Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2026 announcing its corporate name change to AMC Global Media Inc. The company filed Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws solely to effectuate this name change. The company's Class A common stock continues to be listed on NASDAQ under ticker symbol AMCX.
key_points: AMC Networks Inc. changed its corporate name to AMC Global Media Inc. effective April 8, 2026
Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation filed with Nevada Secretary of State
Amended and Restated Bylaws filed solely to effectuate the name change
Class A common stock continues to trade on NASDAQ under ticker AMCX
Outstanding stock certificates for Class A and Class B common stock remain valid
Company also revising description of capital stock via Exhibit 99.1
